why: Words whose content the chip world does not show yet: from the earlier site (retired 2026-11, kept on the branch claude/before-retire-2026-11), and a lens's own form at a level where that lens no longer lives. They wait here for a view, so nothing is lost; tests/i18n.test.mjs does not count them as unused. Move a word out of this list when a view shows it; delete it if it will never be shown.

groups.core: a tiny core running its program
groups.fab: the factory panel that made your design
groups.floor: the energy floor: how little energy a step can take
groups.here: what changed at a level when your chip changed
groups.plant: which building of the factory a station is in
groups.station: when each station of the line happens
groups.xray: die photos: the blocks of a real chip on its die (the earlier site's x-ray)
groups.frame: a lens's own form at a level where it no longer lives, since the field questions lead (#302): Perfect fails at the data centre's building, where Compute beats cleverness now lives through the field question 'scale'
groups.worlds: the eleven worlds as a structure a visitor meets (#305): their index at #/w, the questions from inside them on the first page, a place card's row of the worlds it meets, the map's entry for them; each world is now a reading page opened from a lens
groups.chip: your chip as the earlier site showed it: its Try it panel, the question each setting raises, what each depth shows of it (SHOWS in src/data/weave.js), how a switch is built step by step, and whether memory keeps its cores fed
groups.way: the earlier site's Another way to compute: what each way goes after, its catch, how far it has come
groups.chal: the earlier site's challenge panel: its title, done, and where to change it
